pages.text: $(l)Branded$()$(br)A player wearing the Oathbound Relic and counted by Oathbound systems as part of the burdened path.

$(l)Tremor$()$(br)The Colossus Heart meter. Physical punishment builds it, and it slowly fades out of combat. Higher stages turn Tremor into attack damage, reduced movement burden, and a splash shockwave when enough is stored.

$(l)Heat / Heating Up$()$(br)The Ember Seed meter. Taking and dealing damage build Heat once its combat mechanics awaken. Heat decays over time. More Heat means more movement speed and attack speed, with stronger effects at later stages.
$(l)Reactive Blink$()$(br)The Nebula Lens awakened trigger. A hit can be dodged by blinking away, and the next strike becomes heavily empowered.

$(l)Hollow Dominion$()$(br)A player-facing name for the Void Pearl's awakened darkness aura. In low light, nearby enemies are afflicted with Wither and Weakness; at Apex they are also slowed. Transcendent and Apex stages can additionally strip beneficial effects.

$(l)Renewal$()$(br)A player-facing umbrella term, not a separate registered potion effect. In this codex it means emergency sustain or repeat recovery, usually through Regeneration, Absorption, or both.
